note: Ceilings for scripts/bundle-budget.mjs. Measured on 2026-08-03, then rounded up
for headroom: a budget that fails on every unrelated commit is one somebody
raises without reading. Moving a number here is allowed and is the point — it
has to happen in the same commit as the growth, with the reason in the message.
What they were when they were set:
largest eager chunk    216.2 KB   the main route
eagerBytes moved on 2026-08-13, from 750 KB to 781 KB: the second palette
and the theme gate cost 4.4 KB, and the graph had grown to 747 KB in the
meantime, so it no longer fitted. The 30 KB of new headroom is deliberate:
at 3 KB spare, the ceiling was failing the next commit whatever it was.
The gap between the first two is what the lazy imports are worth: 4.8 MB the
window does not fetch before it can paint, most of it the PDF worker. That is
the measurement those imports never had attached to them.
